_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Broken or faulty chargers
categories.description: Chargers out of order, errors, sessions failing to start or stopping.
keywords: broken|not working|faulty|out of order|error|won'?t (charge|start)|failed to (charge|start)|offline|stopped charging

categories.name: Finding chargers & coverage gaps
categories.description: Too few chargers, charging deserts, highway gaps, range anxiety.

categories.name: Occupied chargers & queues
categories.description: Bays taken by EVs or petrol cars, queues at popular sites.

categories.name: Charging cost & pricing
categories.description: Price per kWh, idle fees, home vs public cost, subscriptions.

categories.name: Slow charging speed
categories.description: Chargers delivering far below rated kW, long charging times.

categories.name: Apps, RFID cards & payment hassles
categories.description: Too many apps, failed payments, accounts and RFID cards.
keywords: \bapp\b|rfid|payment|account|too many apps|wallet|tap to pay|plug and charge

categories.name: Home charger installation
categories.description: Installing a home or apartment charger, society/landlord permission, electricians.

categories.name: Charging network support & refunds
categories.description: No help on site, refunds for failed sessions, double charges.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Apartment dweller
personas.description: No private parking or charger at home.

personas.name: Prospective EV buyer
keywords: should i (buy|get)|thinking of buying|worth (buying|it)|considering an ev
